nodes.name: Receive Research Request
nodes.notes: Entry point. Called by 01 Master Controller with the run context.

nodes.name: Factory Config
nodes.notes: แก้ค่าตั้งค่าทั้งหมดที่ DEFAULTS ในโค้ดของ node นี้ (ดับเบิลคลิกเข้ามาแก้ได้เลย) รองรับ n8n Cloud - ไม่ต้องใช้ environment variable. Order: parent cfg > Variables > env > defaults.

nodes.name: Prompt Library
nodes.notes: Versioned prompts for the two agents used in this workflow.

nodes.name: Normalize Research Input
nodes.notes: Resolves the search keyword (explicit seed or per-factory default).

nodes.name: Check: Etsy Available
nodes.notes: No Etsy key configured -> skip the market sample entirely. Research AI still runs, just without competitor signals.

nodes.name: Skip Etsy Signals
nodes.notes: Records why the market sample is missing so the run stays auditable.

nodes.name: Etsy: Access Token
nodes.notes: Trades the refresh token for a one-hour access token. Etsy mandates PKCE on the authorisation code flow and n8n's OAuth2 credential does not send a code_challenge, so the suite carries a refresh token instead.

nodes.name: Etsy: Search Active Listings
nodes.notes: Live competitor sample for the target keyword. Degrades gracefully: on error the run continues with whatever signals are available.

nodes.name: Etsy: Fetch Taxonomy Nodes
nodes.notes: Official Etsy category tree, used to ground the category suggestion.

nodes.name: Aggregate Etsy Market Signals
nodes.notes: Price percentiles, tag/keyword frequency, competitor count, category hints.

nodes.name: Build Research Prompt
nodes.notes: Renders the Research AI user template with the aggregated signals.

nodes.name: OpenAI: Research AI
nodes.notes: Agent 1/8. Chat Completions with response_format=json_object. OpenAI credential only.

nodes.name: Parse Research JSON
nodes.notes: Validates the 7 required contract fields. Never throws - sets valid=false.

nodes.name: Check: Research Valid
nodes.notes: Valid output continues; anything else falls back to the deterministic concept.

nodes.name: Research Fallback Concept
nodes.notes: Safety net built from Etsy aggregates so a bad completion only degrades the run.

nodes.name: Build Keyword Expansion Prompt
nodes.notes: Renders the SEO AI template in 'keywords' mode.

nodes.name: OpenAI: SEO AI Keyword Expansion
nodes.notes: Agent 5/8 (keywords mode). Expands the concept into Etsy-safe long-tail phrases.

nodes.name: Build Research Output
nodes.notes: Emits the fixed research contract consumed by 03 Product Engine.

nodes.name: Return: Research Package
nodes.notes: Terminal node - its item is the sub-workflow return value.
